scheme_name: Safai Karmakar Hetu Aavashyak Upakaran Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Must be registered with the State Social Security Board in any district of Chhattisgarh.
Should not be receiving assistance from any other parallel scheme of the State Government.
benefits_summary: Grant of ₹700 per year to purchase essential equipment like gum boots, gloves, masks, and aprons.
